sources.quote: We envision a world where humanity thrives . Today, Prime knocks down barriers for philanthropists to deploy charitable capital into a broader set of untapped climate solutions. Our team’s deep philanthropy expertise and commitment to evidence-based assessment of impact and additionality guide philanthropists toward programs they can trust to enable climate change mitigation, adaptation, and resilience. The world’s most complex social and environmental problems — like climate change — will often require the speed and scale of market-based solutions. In 2014, Prime and its growing coalition of visionary philanthropists began deploying catalytic capital alongside traditional grantmaking to mitigate global greenhouse gas emissions through early-stage technology innovation. Today, Prime knocks down barriers for philanthropists to deploy charitable capital into a broader set of untapped climate solutions. Our team’s deep philanthropy expertise and commitment to evidence-based assessment of impact and additionality guide philanthropists toward programs they can trust to enable climate change mitigation, adaptation, and resilience. Over 100 philanthropists that had never made a catalytic investment before have now partnered with Prime on their very first catalytic investment. Explore our team’s research, recent events, program highlights, and the climate solutions Prime has supported
